professional.candidate_source: OpenDota /proMatches, descending IDs until start_time <= cutoff
professional.order: descending match_id; collect first100 eligible or exhaust future population

ranked.candidate_source: OpenDota /parsedMatches, descending pages; intersect public_matches WHERE lobby_type=7 AND game_mode=22 via /explorer
ranked.order: descending match_id; first100 eligible after cutoff; max12pages

eligibility: not in original500 pro or original120 ranked IDs
start_time strictly after latest end_time of any original500pro game
10 distinct validslots and positive hero IDs
allplayers have finite nonnegative lh/gold/xp at600and1200, nondecreasing
sampling_policy.outcomes_unused: Candidate collection and exclusions use eligibility only, never predictions/errors or match win outcome. Both sealed cohorts remain unused for tuning. Model candidate selection uses original400 temporaldevelopment games only.

sampling_limitations: Only five qualifying professional games were available after the strict cutoff; professional results are exploratory.
Public matches are a parsed convenience sample within a narrow time window, not a representative sample of all ranks or dates.
Strict holdout status-zero filtering excludes transient disconnections; original training data allowed them.
Reported position estimates are post-game metadata used for audit slices only, never model inputs.
